newsitem.title: UK: CSFB DIVISION TO LAUNCH RISK MEASUREMENT PRODUCT.
newsitem.headline: CSFB DIVISION TO LAUNCH RISK MEASUREMENT PRODUCT.

text.p: Credit Suisse Financial Products (CSFP), a division of Credit Suisse First Boston, plans to launch a model for evaluating portfolio credit risks, a CSFP spokeswoman said on Monday.
A launch is expected in the months ahead, probably around early October, the official said.

The product will be similar to the CreditMetrics product launched by J.P. Morgan in April, but will use different methods, said John Chrystal, managing director and head of credit derivatives at CSFP in London.
"The model's done. We've been using it within the CS Group," said Chrystal. "The initial focus was for our own use but I think many people saw the potential if this were more widely released."
The spokeswoman said CSFP wanted to ensure that the model was robust. "It not only has to be analytically sound but it also has to be a model which can be implemented," she said.
In April, J.P. Morgan said its CreditMetrics product would create an industry benchmark to quantify risks.
It said the product provided indicators of value at risk due to changes in credit quality caused by upgrades, downgrades and defaults, as well as portfolio concentration.
